story.title: WoW: Forever hits record launch numbers, with more weekly players than in 15 years
story.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever had the biggest concurrent player launch in the MMO's history, according to the report. Executive producer Holly Longdale said over 15 million characters have been logged, and that the game has more people playing weekly than Blizzard has seen in 15 years.

overlappingPost.text: Another fun statistic for you! #WoWForever has more people playing weekly than we've seen in World of Warcraft in 15 years! Thank you all for joining us in Azeroth. We're doing this together, for Forever! 💙♾️
overlappingPost.author: Holly Longdale
